title: An unchecked problem name can redirect inference overwrite outside the output directory
reasoning: problem_name is joined directly to output_path and recursively deleted when overwrite is enabled. Absolute paths discard output_path, and parent-directory components can escape it. Catalog lookup and problem validation happen only after deletion, so even an invalid problem argument can destroy an unrelated directory.
reproduction: With otherwise valid inference arguments and overwrite enabled, supply an existing disposable directory's absolute path as problem_name. That directory is removed before ProblemConfig.from_yaml validates the problem.
recommendation: Validate the problem against the catalog before modifying output, reject names containing path components, and enforce that the resolved destination lies beneath the resolved output directory.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The supplied tests do not exercise infer_problem or its overwrite destination validation.
suggestedRegressionTest: Parameterize absolute paths, parent traversal, and symlink escapes; assert rejection before any output mutation. Also verify that a valid catalog name can overwrite only its intended output directory.
minimumFixScope: Problem resolution and save_dir validation before the destructive overwrite branch.
